803-3510-3875-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-3875-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

883-1981-2415-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5641-5662-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5641-5662-7804.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2506-4772-4836-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

1874-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

240-2292-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

1334-1980-2034-7258.description:
Cast Seasonal Ritual either from your hand or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {G}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Seasonal Ritual.
Resolve both Seasonal Rituals, adding {G}{G} and then exiling the original Seasonal ritual with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Rosethorn Acolyte from exile by paying {2}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rosethorn Acolyte.
Repeat.

4050-4311-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1322-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4693-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4693-5256.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4693-5256.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-5220-6650--53.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2034-5220-6650--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-5220-6650--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

2034-4192-4394-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4693-4826-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4693-4826-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

513-3617-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
513-3617-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
513-3617-6333.description:
Cast Time Walk from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

1-5636-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-5636-5796-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

643-2557-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

101-914-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
101-914-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Dockside Extortionist and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
101-914-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2511-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

240-526-997.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
240-526-997.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

1909-4486-5711.notablePrerequisites: Fanatic of Rhonas does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 4 or greater who has at least a +3/+0 boost from secondary effects.
1909-4486-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat.
1909-4486-5711.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1461-4050-4078-4210.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-4210.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-5034-5131-5330.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5034-5131-5330.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1799-2034-5359-5498.description:
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

980-1734-4605.description:
Cast Glimmerpoint Stag by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glimmerpoint Stag enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter until the next end step.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
At the beginning of your end step, Glimmerpoint Stag triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Glimmerpoint Stag.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter until the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
When the nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glimmerpoint Stag from exile to the battlefield.
When Glimmerpoint Stag enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger, with Glimmerpoint Stag targeting the Fiend Hunter token.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Glimmerpoint Stag that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Glimmerpoint Stag enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the Fiend Hunter token.
When the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

1310-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
1310-4740.description:
Cast Karn's Touch by paying {U}{U}, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

1812-1967-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
1812-1967-2440.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {3}{R}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1000-2743-3924.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{G}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
1000-2743-3924.description:
Cast Deep Forest Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Biovisionary.
Resolve the Deep Forest Hermit trigger, creating four Biovisionary tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
